info.title: Initial setup
info.text: All four reminders are selected, all silent. Use the options below to make a prayer loud or remove reminders you don't want.

prayer.emptyReminder: Select at least one reminder time.

notifications.footer: MIHRAB schedules at most 60 local notifications ahead. When Diyanet times or location are refreshed, the old schedule is cleared and rebuilt with updated times.

qibla.title: Direction of the Kaaba
qibla.subtitle: Hold the phone flat and level with the ground

guidance.calibratePhone: Calibrate by drawing a figure-eight in the air
guidance.webPreview: Live compass works on Android or iOS devices

calibration.title: Calibrate the compass
calibration.text: Move the phone away from metal objects and draw a figure-eight in the air a few times.

tip.title: For best accuracy
tip.text: Magnetic covers, car interiors, speakers, metal tables and electronic devices can affect the compass. Measure in an open area with the phone held horizontally.

tracker.title: Prayer tracker
tracker.trackHint: Mark each prayer after performing it to track your daily routine.

completedDay.title: Alhamdulillah, today is complete
completedDay.text: You have logged all five daily prayers.

info.title: How to use?
info.text: Tap the row of the prayer you performed. If you marked it incorrectly, tap again to undo. This section is for daily on-time tracking; use the separate tracking screen above for missed prayers.

qada.title: Missed prayers

info.title: How does missed prayer tracking work?
info.text: You can enter a debt for each prayer you have missed. Decrease it as you make them up. The debt cannot go below zero.

qada.noDebt: You have no missed prayer debt
qada.dataNotice: Missed prayer records are stored on this device only.

haptics.title: Touch vibration

resetModal.title: Reset session?
